content.thinking: Fast stutter states >16 have no fairness enabled, so no refinement. Should have every state has at least one fair action enabled to avoid fast stutter, but only16 actions and no internal action edges; can add outgoing ai edges to done for all states, then each action enabled many and first bad removes large groups, not16. Could assign one action per vertex cyclically, after first removal still other states disabled all actions? Each state one action; after removing a0 enabled states (~750), remaining states with other actions enabled, no disabled until all16 removals, good. Add for each state i action a(i%16) to done; each action internal none. First bad a0 removes 750, then a1 etc, after16 all states removed -> terminates true (no fair cycle because every state has some strong action enabled and no internal occurrences; any periodic cycle strong violation). This forces16 full SCC computations. Graph m around24k, fine.
